purpose: Machine-readable lifecycle and migration audit for national outdoor data dependencies.

usgsContinuous.source: U.S. Geological Survey Water Data APIs
usgsContinuous.apiVersionRisk: OGC APIs are currently v0; USGS states v0 will overlap with v1 during future migration.
usgsContinuous.apiKey: optional; USGS_API_KEY is server-side only when configured
usgsContinuous.failureMode: Live flow/stage may degrade independently from historical statistics, NWPS and NWS weather.

usgsStatistics.source: U.S. Geological Survey Water Data Statistics API
usgsStatistics.caveat: API is under active beta development; statistics use approved daily values and expose sample_count.
usgsStatistics.failureMode: Historical comparison is optional and must never blank current USGS observations or NOAA/NWS context.

usgsDiscoveryIndex.source: U.S. Geological Survey Water Data APIs
usgsDiscoveryIndex.currentSnapshotProvenance: Existing checked-in index was generated by the legacy Site Service and remains a static provenance snapshot until regenerated.
usgsDiscoveryIndex.generatorRule: Stream sites reporting parameter 00060 within the previous 14 days; paginate and refuse implausibly shallow national output.
usgsDiscoveryIndex.runtimeRule: River discovery reads the local index; selected gauges then receive exact-site current retrieval.

airNow.class: hourly preliminary AQI observations and daily forecasts
airNow.lifecycle: AirNow lists older latitude/longitude and ZIP-specific web-service families for retirement in fall 2026; any smoke build must use the currently supported consolidated services/file feeds.
airNow.cacheGuidance: Observations generally update hourly; forecasts generally update daily.
airNow.dataUse: AirNow observations are preliminary and must be described as such.
airNow.implementationGate: No indexable smoke route until supported endpoints, credentials, cache behavior, attribution and degraded states pass tests.

nasaFirms.transactionLimit: 5000 transactions per 10-minute interval for standard MAP_KEY
nasaFirms.lifecycle: Suomi-NPP product delivery is scheduled to cease November 1, 2026; do not make a new smoke product dependent on VIIRS_SNPP_NRT.
nasaFirms.semantics: A hotspot is a satellite fire/thermal detection, not proof that a specific fire caused smoke at a user location.

nwsMarineBeachForecast.source: NOAA/National Weather Service Marine Beach Forecast Summary
nwsMarineBeachForecast.class: official Day 1 / Day 2 beach forecast guidance
nwsMarineBeachForecast.coverage: U.S. marine beaches including Great Lakes forecast areas where local NWS offices publish the product
nwsMarineBeachForecast.semantics: Official rip-current/swim-risk, surf, winds, weather and water-temperature fields remain forecast guidance tied to the named forecast area.
nwsMarineBeachForecast.dominanceRule: When a High or Moderate official beach-risk category exists, observation or tide context may not downgrade or override it.
nwsMarineBeachForecast.freshnessRule: Treat the issued beach forecast as stale after 24 hours unless a newer Day 1/Day 2 product is retrieved.
nwsMarineBeachForecast.failureMode: NDBC observations and CO-OPS predictions may still render separately; missing NWS coverage must never be converted into Low risk.
nwsMarineBeachForecast.admissionRule: Use NWS beach-forecast geography as the location-admission gate. The searched point must be within 25 miles of the nearest applicable beach-forecast area before NDBC or CO-OPS context can be exposed. Distant source proximity is not coastal eligibility.

ndbcRealtime.class: near-real-time buoy and coastal station observations
ndbcRealtime.stationRule: Choose the nearest active reporting met/water-quality station within the bounded coastal search radius and display its distance.
ndbcRealtime.freshnessRule: Treat selected observations as stale after 90 minutes.
ndbcRealtime.semantics: Wave, wind and water-temperature values are observations at the named station, not proof of exact conditions at a searched beach.
ndbcRealtime.failureMode: A failed or missing NDBC station never creates neutral/favorable coastal conditions and never blanks an available NWS beach forecast.

noaaCoopsTides.source: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services
noaaCoopsTides.queryContract: 36-hour high/low predictions, English units, GMT, MLLW datum at the selected tide-prediction station
noaaCoopsTides.semantics: Predicted high/low tide timing is not observed water level and is not a swim- or boating-safety determination.
noaaCoopsTides.greatLakesRule: Do not invent tide context for Great Lakes locations when no valid CO-OPS tide-prediction station is returned.
noaaCoopsTides.failureMode: Tides degrade independently; missing predictions remain unavailable.

censusTigerwebGeocode.class: U.S. place and ZIP location resolution
censusTigerwebGeocode.rule: Resolve ordinary U.S. city/state and 5-digit ZIP queries from Census TIGERweb before using flexible third-party geocoding.
censusTigerwebGeocode.currentVintage: TIGERweb current place/state layers are January 1, 2025 vintage; current TIGERweb release reflects 2026 BAS boundary work.
censusTigerwebGeocode.failureMode: If Census cannot resolve or is unavailable, fall back to Nominatim; do not fail the location flow from one provider alone.

osmNominatimGeocode.class: flexible geocoding fallback and reverse geocoding
osmNominatimGeocode.rateRule: Public service use remains at or below one request per second; a single 429/5xx retry waits at least 1.1 seconds.
osmNominatimGeocode.failureMode: Nominatim failure must not break ordinary Census-resolvable city/state or ZIP lookups.

gates: No retiring endpoint may be introduced by a new national product.
Missing source credentials must render explicit configuration/degraded state rather than fabricated data.
Source freshness and observation/forecast/derived semantics must remain visible.
One failed source must not blank independent source-backed signals.
National location resolution must not depend on a single upstream geocoder for ordinary U.S. city/state or ZIP queries.
